def VTask.ofLeftInverse : {α : Sort u_3} -> {β : Type u_4} -> (f : α → β) -> (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α) -> (hf : ∀ (h : Nonempty α), Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f) -> α ≃ ↑(Set.range f)
  := @Equiv.ofInjective _ _ f (by
    by_cases hα : Nonempty α
    · -- Case: α is nonempty
      have h_inj : Function.Injective f := by
        intro a₁ a₂ h_eq
        have h₁ : f_inv hα (f a₁) = a₁ := hf hα a₁
        have h₂ : f_inv hα (f a₂) = a₂ := hf hα a₂
        have h₃ : f_inv hα (f a₁) = f_inv hα (f a₂) := by rw [h_eq]
        rw [h₁, h₂] at h₃
        exact h₃
      exact h_inj
    · -- Case: α is empty
      have h_inj : Function.Injective f := by
        intro a₁ a₂ h_eq
        exfalso
        exact Nonempty.false (Nonempty.ofExists ⟨a₁⟩) hα
      exact h_inj
  )
